source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Garden Behind the Science Building
tts_text: Behind the science building at Weston College there is a small garden. The garden is older than the college's master's programme and older than most of the curriculum. A veteran teacher, Mr. Hale, started it thirty years ago. To a layman, the garden looks like a layer of weeds on a layer of old soil. To an amateur gardener, it is a careful piece of art. Mr. Hale is a pioneer of city farming in this state. He rears chickens, keeps rabbits and cultivates fifty kinds of vegetables; he does not breed anything for money. He uses no chemical spray, and he never tires of telling students why. The soil is nourished by leaves, and the plants nourish the people who eat them. Sophomores, juniors and seniors all take a turn in the garden. One sophomore, Lin, is studying sociology. A junior is writing about logic, and a senior is drawing the garden with geometry. There is also a dropout who came back to college at forty. He wants a bachelor's degree, and then perhaps a master's. Mr. Hale says the garden is his masterpiece. He is not the most sophisticated man, but he is the most intelligent one I know. He has a quiet intellect and an intellectual curiosity that never stops. He is articulate too: he can explain a whole season in ten minutes. He acknowledges that he learned most of it from his peers, not from books. His idea is simple: a team is compatible when each person does what he is good at. Every autumn the garden feeds two hundred students.

sentences_cn: 在韦斯顿学院理科楼的后面，有一个小菜园。
这个菜园比学院的硕士项目还老，比大部分课程都老。
三十年前，一位老教师黑尔先生开辟了它。
在外行眼里，这个菜园就是一层野草盖着一层老土。
在业余园艺爱好者眼里，它却是一件用心的艺术品。
黑尔先生是本州都市耕作的先驱。
他养鸡、养兔，还种五十种蔬菜；他养任何东西都不是为了卖钱。
他不用任何化学喷剂，总是不厌其烦地告诉学生为什么。
土壤靠落叶滋养，而植物又滋养吃它们的人。
大二、大三和大四的学生都要轮流到菜园里干活。
有个叫林的大二学生，学的是社会学。
一个大三学生在写关于逻辑的文章，一个大四学生用几何来画这个菜园。
还有一个辍学者，四十岁又回到了学校。
他想拿一个学士学位，然后再读个硕士。
黑尔先生说，这个菜园就是他的代表作。
他不是最精明世故的人，却是我认识的最聪明的人。
他有一颗安静的大脑，和一份从不停止的求知的好奇心。
他也很会表达：十分钟就能把一整季的事讲清楚。
他承认，这些大多是他从同龄人那里学来的，而不是从书本里。
他的想法很简单：当每个人都做自己擅长的事，一个团队就是合得来的。
每年秋天，这个菜园养活两百个学生。
